description: This file contains the CommentController class for managing comment-related actions in a Drupal module, including comment approval, permalink handling, reply form generation, and legacy link redirection.

classes.name: CommentController
classes.description: Controller class for handling comment entity actions such as approval, permalink redirection, reply form rendering, and legacy link redirection within Drupal.

methods.name: commentApprove
methods.description: Publishes a comment and redirects to its permalink.

methods.name: commentPermalink
methods.description: Handles redirecting to the correct comment page based on comment settings, including subrequest handling.

methods.name: commentPermalinkTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the comment permalink page.

methods.name: redirectNode
methods.description: Redirects legacy node URLs to the new comment reply path.

methods.name: getReplyForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the reply form for comments, including parent comment display and entity response.

methods.name: replyFormTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for the reply form page.

methods.name: replyFormAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for replying to a comment or entity.

methods.name: renderNewCommentsNodeLinks
methods.description: Deprecated method to render new comments node links, delegating to the history module.
